records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net sales decreased $110.2 million or 8.5% and $56.0 million or 1.5%, respectively, for the three and nine months ended October 29, 2022 compared to the prior year.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: We generated $1.67 billion in aggregate net proceeds from sales under the ATM Transactions.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The decline in gross profit for the nine months ended October 29, 2022 was primarily attributable to the translation impact of a stronger U.S. dollar, a decline in net sales, higher freight costs driven by supply chain constraints in the first half of the current year, and higher markdown rates on overstock inventory.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: •Improving margins through operational discipline and increased emphasis on higher margin collectibles and pre-owned product categories;

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: During the nine months ended October 29, 2022, cash flows from operating activities were an outflow of $230.0 million, compared with an outflow of $324.0 million during the same period last year.
